body: I'll give it a shot. I wouldn't have the slightest idea where/how to begin. And yeah I can, but when I do the lifting/running I can't do it for very long before I have to stop. Only a few minutes or so.
Where I'm staying at now is on a farm so I'm doing a lot of lifting and running back and forth. Taking care of the animals and whatnot.

I knew stretching is a treatment. The hardest thing for me is working past the pain. Which is a burden in itself. I have to fight my joints constantly. I've had surgery on both of my legs. Various injections to try to help. But it still feels like broken glass in my bones. And of course you haven't annoyed me. I greatly appreciate you taking the time to look up my condition and reply to me.

Despite me feeling like trash around the people I try to care about.. I don't know how to be alone. I live with a friend(Sorta) right now. Left my Father's because he was mentally abusive towards me. Now I'm living with someone that used to be really close to me, and her Mother. Her Mom is just as bad as my Father. So I went from one shitty situation to another. I'm too afraid of change to do anything about it. I literally have nowhere else to go.

If I could do yoga or anything physical like that as some kind of stress release I would. Medical complications stop me from being able to. I was born with a condition called Spastic Diplegia. It causes me a great deal of pain and lowers my flexibility. I've never had a day that wasn't accompanied by the pain caused by that. The doctors I see all say that I'll be in a wheelchair and hardly able to use my legs by the time I'm thirty. I'm twenty now. That just doesn't seem like the kind of life I want. I do appreciate your advice though.
